question: According to the 2011 census, how many districts were there in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**640**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **2011 census**, there were **640 districts** in India.
 
• The census is conducted by the **Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner** under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The census provides comprehensive data on the **population**, **economic activity**, **literacy and education**, **housing** and **household amenities**, **urbanization**, **fertility and mortality**, and **scheduled castes and scheduled tribes**.
 
• The data from the census is crucial for **policy formulation** and **planning** by the government.
 
• Districts are administrative divisions within states and union territories in India, each headed by a **District Magistrate** or a **Deputy Commissioner**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Other Key Information**__

 
 
• The census is conducted every **10 years** in India.
 
• The first census in India was conducted in **1872**, but the first complete census was conducted in **1881**.
 
• The 2011 census was the 15th National census of the country.
 
• India's population as per the 2011 census was approximately **1.21 billion**.
 
• The states with the highest number of districts include **Uttar Pradesh**, **Maharashtra**, and **West Bengal**.
